body: What are the negatives of using fpng? Compatibility?

> What are the negatives of using fpng? Compatibility?

As said in the description, fpng only supports encoding RGB and RGBA frames (libpng does grayscale images too, `FORMAT_L8` and `FORMAT_LA8` in Godot nomenclature). fpng also generates larger files (1.69× the size of libpng for my example above), but that probably isn't a big deal.

fpng's readme says "The files written by fpng conform to the PNG standard, are readable using any PNG decoder [...]", so compatibility is not a concern.

@Chaosus btw: `topic:import` should probably be `topic:export`.

fpng does have a decompressor too ("2.5-3x faster decompression"), but this doesn't enable it (though `wuffs`'s PNG decoder is even faster and more secure) :)

Can you benchmark https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/80768 on the same machine to see which one is faster (QOI versus fpng)? Recent FFmpeg versions accept QOI as input files. Reading this PR description, it seems fpng is quite a bit faster than QOI, so I'd be interested to know about file sizes too.

Personally, I'd be OK with replacing libpng with fpng for encoding. It would make saving screenshots much faster too, which would reduce the pause you see when you use in-game screenshot functionality. If you need more efficient (but slower) image saving, there's always lossless WebP (`Image.save_webp()`).

We could also choose to keep libpng supported and use it automatically when writing a format that fpng doesn't support.
